Teased banner status

Teased banners stay separate from next upcoming banners until official notices lock the phase, reruns, and featured 5★ rate-ups.

Summon Rules

Limited banner pity carries over

Your guaranteed 6-star counter carries over between limited character banners - pulls on one limited banner are not lost when it ends. However the one-time 120 pull hard pity that guarentees the limited rate-up character does not carry over.

Weapon banner pulls are seperate

Weapon Banners in Arknights Endfield use an entirely different pull currency than character banners which can be acquired through pulling on character banners. Weapon banners have different durations to character banners and also have seperate pities.

Standard banner is separate

The permanent standard banner has its own pool and pity and does not share progress with limited banners.

FAQ

When Does The Current Banner End?

Each banner card shows a live countdown and the exact end date for your selected server region.

What is the current Arknights Endfield Banner?

The current Arknights Endfield banners are listed in the Current Banners section above, with their featured 6 Stars and end dates

Who is the next Arknights Endfield banner?

The next confirmed banners appear in the Next Banners sections with their expected release date. Teased characters that are not yet scheduled are listed separately under Upcoming Banners. If no characters have been officially teased by the developers these sections may not be present on the banner page temporarily.

What is the difference between next and upcoming

Next banners have an officially announced or strongly indicated schedule. Upcoming banners have only been revealed and stay marked TBA until an official notice locks the phase and dates.

How Frequently Are Banners Updated

The Prydwen team aims to update banner schedules within 24 hours of their official release but will always wait for official confirmation on information before publication and will not use leaks.
